title: 第19章 身边的魔鬼老刘不演了第20章 开武馆养老偶遇大春
slug: 一年抽取一词条模拟的也可以
lines: 【老刘的身上，开始溢散出阵阵诡异的黑雾。
【抬手间，一面黑烟滚滚的幡旗，从他体内飞出，迎风便涨，化作数丈高大！
【你在这面幡旗上，看到了很多人脸，它们拼命的想从里面冲出来，龇牙咧嘴面目狰狞，发出鬼哭狼嚎的恐怖厉啸！
【你当场就认出来了。
【因为在第一次模拟中，同样是这一年，在你四十岁的时候，白云县有一位手持万魂幡的魔道武者，在县城大肆屠戮，还害死了你的女儿。
【“哦？陈老大你也认识这宝贝？果然是宝物，名气就是大啊。”
【老刘轻轻的抚摸着万魂幡，一脸爱不释手的表情。
【这一路上，尾随在你身后的杀人狂魔，不是别人，正是老刘！
【难怪他经常会消失一段时间。
【你不是没有怀疑过他。
【可老刘在你面前只流露过炼体境的实力，也从没暴露过万魂幡，你实在没法将他和能屠村的恶人联系到一起。
【你仔细回忆了第一次模拟的记忆，发现其实没看见过那个魔道武者的正脸。
【说不定真是同一个人。
【但也可能是另一个捡到万魂幡的人。
【“咳咳！
那些村民……他们那么热情的招待我们，还有那些孩子……你怎么下得去手！”
【老刘满不在乎。
【“只要能供养万魂幡，万魂幡就会反哺我修为，我这么差的资质，短短六年，就达到了淬魂境！
若是正常修炼怎么可能？这可真是个……好宝贝……”
【他的双眼已经被一种诡异的痴迷充斥。
content_en:
[Lao Liu’s body began to emit bursts of strange black mist.
[As he raised his hand, a flag with billowing black smoke flew out of his body and swelled in the wind, becoming several feet tall!
[You can see many human faces on this flag. They are trying desperately to rush out, baring their teeth and looking ferocious, making terrifying screams like ghosts crying and wolves howling!
【"Ten Thousand Souls Banner?!"
[You recognized it on the spot.
[Because in the first simulation, in the same year, when you were forty years old, there was a demonic warrior in Baiyun County holding the Ten Thousand Soul Banner, who massacred in the county and even killed your daughter.
["Oh? Boss Chen, do you also know this treasure? It is indeed a treasure, and its reputation is great."
[Lao Liu gently stroked the Ten Thousand Souls Flag, with an expression on his face that he couldn't put it down.
[The murderous maniac following you along the way is none other than Lao Liu!
[No wonder he often disappears for a while.
[It’s not like you haven’t doubted him.
[But Lao Liu has only shown the strength of the Body Refining Realm in front of you, and has never revealed the Ten Thousand Souls Banner. You really can't connect him with a villain who can massacre a village.
[You carefully recalled the memory of the first simulation and found that you had never seen the face of the demonic warrior.
[Maybe they are really the same person.
[But it could also be another person who picked up the Ten Thousand Souls Flag.
["Ahem!
Those villagers... they entertained us so warmly, and those children... how could you do this! "
[Old Liu doesn’t care.
["As long as I can support the Ten Thousand Souls Banner, the Ten Thousand Souls Banner will support my cultivation. With such poor qualifications, I have reached the Soul Tempering Realm in just six years!"
How is it possible if it is a normal practice? This is really a...good baby..."
[His eyes have been filled with a strange obsession.
title_en: Chapter 19 The devil around me, Old Liu, no longer plays Chapter 20 Opening a martial arts gym for retirement and meeting Dachun by chance
